title: Only Down Challange
description: A mod that challenges you by preventing you from going down. Small knockback is allowed, as without it, the challenge would be too difficult. This idea is inspired by the German YouTuber BastiGHG.
body:
# Mod Explanation: Only Down Challenge

## Explanation

This mod introduces a hardcore vertical movement restriction to Minecraft, creating a intense survival challenge. Once a world is generated, the mod immediately activates, giving strict rules on how high players can travel. The primary mechanic is simple but punishing: 
- If you move even a single block above your current highest Y-coordinate, you instantly die.
- If you die youre put in to the spectator mode

This means that from the moment you spawn, every movement downward is permanent—you can never backtrack upward without fatal consequences.

## Example

1. World Creation & Spawn

- You generate a new world and spawn in a forest biome at Y=86, standing on top of a tree.
- Since this is your initial spawn height, Y=86 becomes your maximum allowed Y-level.
- If you attempt to climb higher (e.g., jumping to Y=87), you instantly die and are put into Spectator mode.

2. First Descent: From Tree to Ground

- You carefully descend from the tree to the ground, lowering your position to Y=81.
- Now, your new maximum allowed Y-level is Y=81—you can never go back up to Y=86.
- If you try to climb the tree again, jump, or even step onto a one-block ledge (Y=82), you die immediately.

3. Mining & Permanent Consequences

- To gather resources, you dig downward, eventually reaching Y=-20 while mining for diamonds.
- Now, your maximum permitted Y-coordinate is locked at Y=-20.
- This creates a devastating problem:
You cannot return to the surface—any attempt to go above Y=-20 kills you.
Essential surface-based gameplay (e.g., defeating the Ender Dragon, exploring villages, or even accessing the Nether portal) becomes impossible unless you never ascend during the entire playthrough.

## Requirements
- The mod is required Client- and Serverside
